title: Choose Life and Multiply Your Faith
description: This week, Pastor Chris Zehner takes us on a journey through the book of Deuteronomy, exploring how to increase our faith and experience breakthrough in our lives. By examining the commands of God and the consequences of obedience, Pastor Chris shows us that living a life of faith is not only possible, but it's also the key to living a life of abundance and prosperity. Join us as we discover how to choose life and live a life that honors God.
